name: Tsuchikasu Kenta
source: A regular guy at school. Fundamentally kind and thoughtful, but because of that, people tend to see him as lacking assertiveness. He’s become a bit timid after being teased about his demeanor. Familiar with Aoi since childhood and feels grateful for her constant support, along with developing romantic feelings for her. However, his inferiority complex prevents him from confessing his feelings.
